articles.title: Is There a Giant Cave Under the Moon? NASA Wants to Find Out
articles.summary: NASA picked a project called GIMLI to learn whether a pit on the Moon leads to a hidden lava tube cave.

articles.title: This Year's El Niño Is Breaking Records
articles.summary: Daily ocean temperatures show 2026's El Niño is the strongest on record so far, and it may still grow.

articles.title: Scientists Find New Giant Stick Insects in Australia
articles.summary: Australian scientists learned that two kinds of giant stick insects are really five, including one with lidded eggs.
